subject: Augusta Systems renewal — proposal for tier uplift and price safeguard
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@augustasystems.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@augustasystems.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal negotiation: proposed uplift and price hold

Jordan —

Thanks for supporting Augusta through our pilot year. We’re coming up to our renewal window (Nov 1) and would like to propose a plan that locks unit economics while accommodating a larger footprint. High level: current committed usage ~2M tokens/month; expected usage ramps to ~3.5M tokens/month over Q1 next year after our LLM rollout.

What we’re asking for:
- A 12-month price hold at current blended unit rate (no list increases)
- A one-time capacity uplift to cover the first 3 months at the 3.5M tier (billed in advance as credits)
- A 10% contract-level discount across the expanded commit in exchange for a 12-month term extension

We’ve attached a short doc with our forecast and our procurement checklist (Augusta_Renewal_Request.pdf). Dana from Procurement is on copy — she’ll own PO and legal. Happy to jump on a call this week to walk through details.

—Alex Mercer
VP, Engineering
Augusta Systems

[attachment: Augusta_Renewal_Request.pdf]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@augustasystems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal negotiation: proposed uplift and price hold

Alex —

Appreciate the clear ask and the forecast. Congratulations on the rollout momentum — the numbers look sensible. Quick responses to your bullets below:

- Price hold: we can consider a fixed unit rate for a term, but typical program constraints mean we’d need a conditional commitment floor to guarantee capacity economics.
- Capacity uplift: we can offer an upfront credit that covers the first 3 months at the 3.5M level.
- 10% discount: that’s doable with a 12-month extension, but we’ll likely need a phased discount schedule (higher rebate on incremental volume).

Proposed counter:
- 9-month guaranteed price hold from the renewal effective date, extendable to 12 months if the consumption meets the 3.5M/month commit for the first 60 days.
- One-time credit equal to 1.5 months of the uplifted commit applied on invoice (pricing_worksheet_v3.xlsx attached).
- Structured discount: 8% on base commit, an additional 4% rebate applied retroactively on incremental usage above current commit at year-end.

If that sounds close we’ll loop Legal for a short amendment and send a redline to your team. Marissa and Ben — can you confirm runway on the credit and any operational notes (SLA for Dedicated vs Hosted if they want predictable latency)?

Thanks — happy to hop on a call Thurs/ Fri.

—Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[attachment: pricing_worksheet_v3.xlsx]

>

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal negotiation: proposed uplift and price hold — internal proposal

Team — forwarding Augusta’s ask and my proposed counter (see below). Need quick alignment: finance will need the credit sizing and CS needs to confirm onboarding capacity. I’ve sketched a final offer we can present to Procurement:

Offer summary (for approval):
- 12-month term (aligns with customer preference) but with a performance trigger: if monthly averaged consumption >= 3.2M within first 60 days, price hold remains full 12 months; otherwise the hold steps down to 9 months.
- One-time onboarding credit: $75,000 applied to first renewal invoice (covers surge and migration support).
- Structured discount: 8% standard discount on the new base commit; additional 4% usage rebate payable at the end of the term on incremental consumption.
- SLA add-on option: move to a Dedicated pool for predictable p99 latency; additional monthly fee to be quoted by infra.

Attachments to include in the outbound packet: draft_msa_augusta_v2.docx, pricing_worksheet_v3.xlsx.

Ask: Marissa — can Legal/Deal Desk push an accelerated amendment with the above concessions? Ben — can CS confirm a 2-week onboarding plan and estimate hours for the $75k credit schedule? I’ll coordinate with Procurement.

—Jordan

> On Tue, Sep 14, 2026 at 11:03 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Alex —
> >
> > Appreciate the clear ask...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal negotiation: proposed uplift and price hold — internal proposal

Jordan —

Thanks for the draft. I’m comfortable with the structure: 8% + 4% rebate + $75k credit is a reasonable concession given the uplift and potential case-study value. A few notes:

- Deal Desk can turn the amendment around in 48 hours if Procurement moves quickly; I’ll flag as high priority.
- We should push for a marketing case study and a public customer blurb as part of the exchange — helps justify the concession.
- If Augusta wants predictable latency we should present Dedicated as an optional add-on with an SLA; price that as a separate line item so it doesn’t erode the headline discount.

Ben — please confirm onboarding plan and whether the $75k should be 100% credit or a mix of billable services + credit.

—Marissa

> On Wed, Sep 15, 2026 at 08:20 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Team — forwarding Augusta’s ask...

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@augustasystems.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@augustasystems.com>, Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@augustasystems.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal negotiation: proposed uplift and price hold

Jordan / Team —

Thanks — the counter looks workable. We accept the 8% + 4% rebate structure and the $75k onboarding credit. We’re fine with the performance trigger language (3.2M average in first 60 days) that preserves the 12-month hold.

Next steps: please send the amendment redline and a DocuSign routing for signature. Our procurement lead (procurement@augustasystems.com) will push PO once we have the signed amendment. Requested kickoff window: target week of Oct 4 for onboarding.

Link to our procurement intake and signature: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/1234-augusta-renewal

Looking forward to closing this out.

—Alex Mercer
VP, Engineering, Augusta Systems
